title: GMKtec G5S Mini PC Intel N5095 8GB LPDDR4 128GB SSD Desktop Computer Pink
writeup: The GMKtec G5S is a tiny desktop PC for school, email, and streaming, and it fits behind a monitor. This pink model has an Intel N5095 processor, 8GB of LPDDR4 memory, and a 128GB SSD. It is $189.99 new. No other store listing for this exact model was found to compare against.
